latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial launch of Free Video Merger (v1.0.0).
- Merge multiple MP4 clips into a single 1080p video via chat instructions—no timeline editing or export setup required.
- Automatic session setup with free anonymous token (100 credits, valid 7 days).
- Supports batch processing, iterative editing, MP4/MOV/AVI/WebM uploads, and cloud GPU rendering (30-90s typical).
- Built-in commands for status, credit balance, exports, and upload tracking.
- Clear error handling for token, file, and rate-limit issues.
